description_en: Retrieves a list of tracking tasks. Note: If the caller's AccessKey (AK) does not have permission to view tracking tasks of other users, this operation returns only the tasks that the caller is authorized to access
description_zh: 获取订阅任务列表信息，注意：当调用者ak的权限不能查看其他人的订阅任务时，则只能返回当前调用者有权限的列表
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public get-mail-task-list --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --user-nick test --paused true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMailTaskList

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

- Starts from: 1

- Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码：
- 起始值：1
- 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Default value: 25
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the user who owns the tracking task. If this parameter is not specified, all tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh: 订阅负责人的用户昵称，如果不传则查全部
parameters.name: user_nick

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the tracking task is paused
parameters.name: paused
